item.title: Clayface Delayed 6 Weeks, Practical Magical 2 Moves Up A Week
item.description: Warner Bros. has shifted the release dates of two of its fall releases: Clayface from DC Studios has moved up by 6 weeks, while Practical Magic 2 has moved up by 1 week.
